fee_notes: Royalty 6% of Net Sales paid weekly. Advertising Contribution 3% of Net Sales for most Shoppes; 2.5% for Cinnabon Co-Branded Shoppes (except Swirl) in Other Locations; 3% for Swirl Shoppes; does not apply to Hosted Express Shoppes. Local Marketing Obligation: 2% of Net Sales per quarter (1% for Ice Cream Trucks or Co-Branded Shoppes). Advertising Contribution + Local Marketing Obligation capped at 5% of Net Sales collectively.
